title: drosera aberrans
intro: Drosera aberrans, commonly known as the Western Sundew, is a carnivorous plant species belonging to the Droseraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve coughs, and soothe respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Drosera aberrans are attributed to its expectorant properties, which help to loosen and clear mucus from the lungs, making it a popular treatment for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include iridoid glycosides, such as secologanin and loganin, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
